mainEntity.name: How long does a whole-home remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home remodel varies significantly based on the project's complexity and scope. A typical project, involving multiple rooms and some structural modifications, can take anywhere from 3 to 12 months from planning to completion. Factors such as design finalization, material lead times, permitting processes, and the extent of demolition and reconstruction all influence the timeline. We work to establish a realistic schedule during the initial planning phase, providing clear milestones so you know what to expect.
